title: functional mismatch
symptoms: The completed simulation reports one or more output mismatches
possible_causes: A reset or enable behavior error
An incorrect state transition or edge timing
inspection_steps: Inspect the first reported mismatched output and the public specification
Inspect bounded waveform evidence and the RTL driving that output
repair_guidance: Prefer the smallest RTL change consistent with the observed failure and specification
limitations: Mismatch count alone does not establish root cause
VCD samples are end-of-timestamp values, not exact testbench sampling events; do not infer an exact failure cycle or expected/actual pair
